Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Contabilitate și Servicii financiare
This is Worldline 
 We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. The solutions our people build today power the growth of millions of businesses tomorrow. From your local coffee shop to unicorns and international banks. From San Francisco to Auckland. We are in every corner of the world, in every part of commerce. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape evolution.
 The Opportunity 
 At Worldline, our technology addresses the persistent challenges of the payment world. We design and operate leading digital payment and transactional solutions that enable sustainable economic growth and reinforce trust and security in our societies
 Day-to-Day Responsibilities 
Be part of an international team finding vulnerabilities & threats before someone else finds them for us
Organize penetration tests with our external suppliers and internal teams across all countries worldwide
Act as an active member regarding offensive security activities performed internally and externally
Participate in security investigations and threat analysis activities within the Cyber Controls scope
Provide security support for the technical and organizational aspects of pentest operations
Participate in international alignment and standardization workshops for pentest methodologies
Create and maintain process descriptions, documentation, and KPIs for pentest organization
Support and participate in audits by providing information, reports, and comprehensive documentation
Implement and work with complex security tools best on the market for pentest execution and management
Deliver security testing services for the company across all countries and provide support to our CERT
 Who We Are Looking For 
 We look for big thinkers. People who can drive positive change, step up and show what’s next – people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. In practice this means:
Security knowledge and understanding of systems, networks, and common vulnerabilities relevant to offensive security testing
Fluent in English (talking and writing as we are an international team)
Communication skills and ability to deal with people and manage supplier relationships
Network knowledge and understanding of infrastructure and system architectures
Vulnerability knowledge and understanding of common attack scenarios and defensive bypass techniques
Ability to coordinate and communicate with multiple stakeholders, from CISO to technical teams to external suppliers
Strong team player with ability to work independently and manage multiple pentest campaigns simultaneously
Problem-solving mindset with attention to detail and ability to manage complex supplier relationships
Certification in offensive security (OSCP, CEH, GPEN, or equivalent pentest methodology certification)
Experience in managing pentest suppliers and coordinating external security services
Experience organizing bug bounty programs and managing public disclosure processes; financial services, payments, or PCI-DSS regulated environments
Knowledge of pentest tools and frameworks (Metasploit, Burp Suite, etc.) and testing methodologies
 Perks & Benefits 
 At Worldline you’ll get the chance to be at the heart of the global payments technology industry and shape how the world pays and gets paid. On top of that, you will also:
Annual performance bonus
Work from home allowance
Meal vouchers, gift vouchers on the occasion of Christmas/Easter Holidays
Private Medical Care
Life Insurance
Full access to the “LinkedIn Learning” platform
Access to Bookster library and Wellbeing platform
1 free day for your birthday
 Shape the evolution 
 We are on an exciting journey toward the next frontiers of payments technology, and we look for big thinkers, people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. Here you’ll work with ambitious colleagues from around the world, take on unique challenges as a team, and make a real impact on the society. With an empowering culture, strong technology and extensive training opportunities, we help you accelerate your career - wherever you decide to go. Join our global team of 18,000 innovators and shape a tomorrow that is yours to own.
 Learn more about life at Worldline at jobs.worldline.com 
 We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as an individual with a disability, or any applicable legally protected characteristics.
